activities.name: Zao Ropeway — Juhyo (Snow Monster) Tour
activities.notes: Two-stage ropeway to the Jizo Sancho station at 1,661 m, with the iconic juhyo (ice-encrusted firs) at the upper section. Famous evening light-up tours Jan-mid-Mar.

activities.name: Zao Jizo Bosatsu
activities.address: Jizo Sancho Station area, Zao Onsen, Yamagata-shi, Yamagata 990-2301
activities.notes: 2.34 m stone Jizo statue at the top of Zao Ropeway, said to protect travellers and skiers. In winter only its head is visible above the juhyo — Zao's most photographed sight.

activities.name: Shimoyu Public Bathhouse
activities.notes: One of three free-flowing public soto-yu in Zao Onsen. Strongly acidic sulphur water (~pH 1.6); small wooden bath, no shower, donation 200 yen.

activities.name: Kawarayu Public Bathhouse
activities.notes: Streamside public bath in the lower village. The most photogenic of Zao's three free soto-yu; wooden architecture and cloudy white water.

activities.name: Zao Onsen Dai-Rotenburo
activities.notes: Huge open-air bath set in the forest above the village. Seasonal — typically open mid-April through mid-November (closed in deep winter).

activities.name: Yamadera (Risshaku-ji) Temple
activities.notes: 1,000-step mountain temple immortalised in a Bashō haiku. 20 minutes by JR Senzan Line from Yamagata Station; classic day-trip out of Zao.
